title: GHL → Inbound: duplicate event is deduped (idempotency)
prodMutationClass: create+delete (self-clean, no real GHL account touched)
journey: Off-camera: POST a signed ContactCreate for a unique contact → processed (client created)
Off-camera: POST a second signed webhook for the same contact + event type
Open GHL Integration → Sync Events on staging web
Confirm the first event is 'processed' and the duplicate is 'skipped' (Duplicate event skipped) — deduped by (location, contact, eventType) eventKey
Proves inbound is idempotent: a re-delivered webhook does not double-create the client
